subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for FinServCorp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: John Linton <john.linton@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for FinServCorp

Hi John / team,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today — really appreciated the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight POC to validate fit based on what we discussed. I've attached a one-page POC outline (20260914-poc-outline.pdf) and our baseline SLA for reference.

Demo recap (2 min):
- Showed Redwood inference platform: hosted API, dedicated options, routing and caching knobs.
- Focus areas for FinServCorp: low tail latency for customer-facing assistants, cost predictability for batch batch-embedding jobs, and audit/logging for compliance.
- Primary evaluation workloads: 1) customer support summarization (latency + quality), 2) daily batch embeddings for search/retrieval (throughput/cost).

Proposed POC (2-4 weeks, low-friction):
1) Objectives / success criteria:
   - Summarization: output quality >= current baseline on your internal eval set (we'll measure with ROUGE/F1 + manual spot checks)
   - Latency: p95 generation latency < 200ms for typical query length (as measured on our hosted API in us-west)
   - Embeddings: throughput target of ~1M embeddings/day with effective cost < $X per 1k embeddings (we'll model after seeing sample job)
   - Security: logs + audit proofing available; SOC2 artifacts provided
2) Scope:
   - Two workloads (summarization + embeddings), single team pilot (Customer Success / Search)
   - Use Redwood hosted eval environment (option to move to Dedicated if needed)
3) Timeline (proposed):
   - Week 0 (kickoff, sign-off on NDA if needed): 2026-09-20
   - Week 1 (data handoff + baseline runs): 2026-09-21 to 2026-09-24
   - Week 2 (tuning + golden-run experiments): 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-01
   - Week 3 (final evaluation + wrap): 2026-10-04 to 2026-10-08
4) Ownership:
   - Redwood: Marissa Cole (AM) + Rishi Malhotra (Solutions Eng) for setup and tuning
   - FinServCorp: John Linton (ML lead) + Priya Shah (security/compliance) for data, eval, and acceptance
5) Requirements from FinServCorp:
   - Sample eval set for summarization (10-50 documents + scoring rubric)
   - Access to a representative embeddings job or sample CSV with schemas
   - Point of contact for security questionnaire (Priya?) and a short list of accepted IP/secret handling steps
6) Acceptance criteria / deliverables:
   - Short report with latency/cost measurements and quality comparisons against baseline
   - A plan for next steps (Dedicated quote or rollout) if success criteria met

Next steps I propose:
- Confirm pilot start date (we penciled 2026-09-20)
- Share the sample data and a primary contact for security
- Quick 30-min kickoff meeting to align owners and access (I can send a calendar invite for Tue/Wed next week)

Thanks — happy to adjust any of the above.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: 20260914-poc-outline.pdf, redwood-sla-2026.pdf

From: John Linton <john.linton@finservcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finservcorp.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for FinServCorp

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and the outline, this is very helpful. A few notes from our side after syncing with Priya:  

- Security / compliance: Priya will own the questionnaire and initial review. She asked if you can share SOC2 report and a short data handling doc separate from the SLA (redwood-sla-2026.pdf helps).
- Timeline: the dates look good. We'd prefer a start of 2026-09-27 instead of 2026-09-20 to give our infra team a week to prepare the embeddings job and to run an internal compliance pre-check. Is that okay?
- Ownership: I'll be the ML lead on evaluation, Priya will be our security/compliance point. I'd also like Rishi from your solutions team on the kickoff to go through ingest/connectivity.
- Success metrics: one ask — can we add an operational criterion around retrain latency for embeddings refresh (i.e., time to generate embeddings for a 100k document refresh job)? We care about end-to-end refresh windows.

If you can shift kickoff to 2026-09-27 and send the SOC2 + data handling note, we'll get the sample data and rubric to you by 2026-09-24.

Thanks,
John Linton
Director of ML, FinServCorp
john.linton@finservcorp.com

We'll also attach SOC2 and a two-page data handling summary (separate from the SLA) to the calendar invite and share the Drive link to the POC outline here: https://drive.redwood.com/finservcorp/poc-outline

Next steps for us:
- I'll send the kickoff invite for Tue 2026-09-28 (let me know availability) and attach SOC2 + data handling note.
- Rishi will post a short technical checklist by tomorrow.
- Please send sample data and rubric by 2026-09-24 as discussed.

Looking forward — we'll keep this light and data-driven.
